title: Acid-Base Titration: Find the Endpoint
subtitle: Add base drop-by-drop and stop at the indicator change
description: Discovery-based chemistry lab. Add a strong base to a strong acid drop by drop and stop the moment the universal indicator changes color.
reflection_prompt: How did you decide when to slow down to drop-by-drop additions, and what told you the endpoint was near?
learning_objectives: Understand the equivalence point in acid-base titrations
Practice careful observation near the endpoint
Connect pH change with indicator color
coaching: Watch the color carefully — small drops near the endpoint are crucial.
